dag.description: Base PyTorch end-to-end with percentile (rank) score calibration. A Cradle baseline dataset is preprocessed and used to train a PyTorch classifier; a separate Cradle calibration dataset is preprocessed and scored by the trained model via PyTorchModelInference, then PercentileModelCalibration produces rank-bucketed scores for threshold enforcement. The model is packaged (Package) and payload-tested (Payload) and registered. This is the plain percentile pipeline — no stratified sampling, tokenizer training, Bedrock labeling, or hybrid stacking.

agent_context.when_to_use: Standard end-to-end PyTorch classifier with percentile (rank) score calibration for threshold-based enforcement, sourced from Cradle. Use as the base pattern when you do NOT need stratified sampling, tokenizer training, Bedrock/LLM labeling, or hybrid XGBoost stacking — e.g. the steady-state retrain DAG for munged_address_pytorch and rnr_pytorch_bedrock (dag.json). Calibration scoring uses PyTorchModelInference on a held-out Cradle calibration set.
agent_context.when_not_to_use: If you need class-balanced training, use pytorch_stratified_percentile_e2e (adds StratifiedSampling). If you need a learned tokenizer, use pytorch_tokenizer_percentile_e2e. If you want probability calibration rather than percentile buckets, use complete_e2e (PyTorchModelEval + ModelCalibration). If you need LLM-derived labels or embeddings, use a bedrock e2e or pytorch_hybrid_xgboost_e2e.
differentiators: Minimal PyTorch percentile-calibration E2E — no stratified sampling / tokenizer / Bedrock front-end
Training loader is a Cradle baseline set (CradleDataLoading_baseline); calibration uses a separate Cradle set

prerequisites.check: Cradle SQL for training baseline and calibration
prerequisites.how: CradleDataLoading_baseline and CradleDataLoading_calibration profiles return labeled rows

common_pitfalls: Package consumes PyTorchTraining output (the model), not the PercentileModelCalibration output
PyTorchModelInference_calibration needs BOTH the trained model and the preprocessed calibration data
Use the same preprocessing config for the baseline and calibration branches
